about_the_game:
Imagine a one-of-a-kind gaming experience where you're not the typical hero or survivor but instead the architect of fear itself. Roles are reversed!
In this real-time strategy game, you become the embodiment of horror.
Your mission is to manipulate every element of the game world, lurking in the shadows and orchestrating spine-chilling moments.
Your target?
A very popular streamer who is bravely playing the game. Your goal is to craft an atmosphere of tension, conjure up heart-pounding scares, and ultimately, send shivers down the streamer's spine at precisely the right time. It's a completely fresh take on the horror genre, where you are the mastermind behind the fear, and your success hinges on your ability to terrify the streamer. If you're intrigued by the idea of becoming the horror itself, then wishlist now!

Control anything



In this game, you can interact with nearly all in-world objects as well as many more stuff to create the perfect scary moment!

Watch the streamer closely




Be a good game and improve the streams success



You start with a set amount of energy. based on the difficulty settings Your job is to strategically build up tension to then scare the streamer. When you have a good harmony of tension and scares, the viewer count will increase as the stream is very entertaining. With more viewers, you can get more energy to continue the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or new-gen i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements can change
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 9500+ Series)
  • Graphics: ntel i7 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 9500+ Series)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: In this reversed horror strategy game, YOU become the horror game yourself. Be the mastermind behind the shadows and control paranormal activities. Craft tension by creating eerie anomalies, hunt down a popular streamer who plays you, and jumpscare the streamer at the perfect moment!
